This '''swamp''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The [[Andrevea River]] emptied into it.<ref name="TCSWE" /> During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] [[Skirmishes in the Naboo countryside|attacked]] a [[Trading village (Naboo swamps)|village]] in the swamp.<ref name="BfN" />
